class.name: ThespeonInput
class.brief_description: Describes what a [Thespeon] node should say, and how.
class.description: One synthesis input: a character, default language and emotion, and one or more text segments that can each override the language, emotion, speed and loudness. A new input has English as its default language and no segments. The setters reject only malformed arguments. Other problems, such as no character being set, are reported by [method to_json], [method Thespeon.validate_input] and the synthesis methods. [b]Note:[/b] An input must not be used from two threads at once.

method.name: add_segment
method.description: Appends a segment of text and returns its index, or [code]-1[/code] on error. Use the index with the [code]segment_*[/code] methods. A sample-request marker ([code]◎[/code], U+25CE) in [param text] reports where in the audio it falls, through [signal ThespeonAudioStream.samples_requested].

method.name: from_json
method.description: Creates an input from a JSON document, such as one made by [method to_json]. Returns [code]null[/code], and prints an error, if the document is invalid.

method.name: segment_add_emotion
method.description: Adds [param emotion] with [param weight] to the emotion blend at the start or end of [param segment]. Adding an emotion that is already in the blend replaces its weight.

method.name: segment_set_custom_pronounced
method.description: If [param enabled] is [code]true[/code], the text of [param segment] is read as IPA rather than as ordinary text.

method.name: segment_set_emotion
method.description: Sets a single emotion for [param segment], used at any endpoint that has no blend from [method segment_add_emotion]. An empty [param emotion] unsets it.

method.name: segment_set_language
method.description: Overrides the language of [param segment]. [param language] has the same keys as in [method set_default_language]. An empty [Dictionary] unsets the override.

method.name: segment_set_loudness
method.description: Sets the loudness at the start or end of [param segment].

method.name: segment_set_speed
method.description: Sets the speaking speed at the start or end of [param segment].

method.name: set_character
method.description: Selects the character by name, optionally narrowed by [param module_type] and [param module_version]. Replaces any module set with [method set_character_module].

method.name: set_character_module
method.description: Selects the character by module identifier. Replaces any character set with [method set_character].

method.name: set_default_emotion
method.description: Sets the emotion used by segments that set none. An empty [param emotion] unsets it. See [method Thespeon.get_emotions_for_character] for the emotions a character supports.

method.name: set_default_language
method.description: Sets the language used by segments that set none. [param language] has the keys [code]iso639_2[/code] (required), [code]iso639_3[/code], [code]glottocode[/code], [code]iso3166_1[/code], [code]iso3166_2[/code] and [code]custom_dialect[/code]. [codeblock] input.set_default_language({ "iso639_2": "eng" }) [/codeblock]

method.name: to_json
method.description: Returns the input as a JSON document, which [method from_json] can read back. Validates the input as the synthesis methods do, and returns an empty [String], printing an error, if it is invalid.
